name: crawl
description: Read web pages as Markdown and data: scrape a URL, crawl a site or section, map a site's URLs, check which of many sites load, or search Google. Uses plain HTTP first and the user's browser (with their logins) when needed.

columns.description: For find: column name -> what to fill in.

criteria.description: For find: what every row must be.

file.description: For check: a workspace file listing hosts or URLs.

query.description: Search terms, or what to look for: ranks pages and keeps relevant parts.

via.description: For check: http never starts Chrome.

paths.description: For check: paths to probe on every host, e.g. ["/api/x"].

expect.description: For check: what those paths should answer (json, html, m3u8, xml, text or a content type); the body's real shape is checked.

readiness.description: For check: open each site and report typed readiness (ready, empty, loading, login, challenge, not-found, error) with evidence.

name: site_mapper
description: Call a site's abilities (actions: sites, operations, call, ability, watch, channel), see its published docs, keep it working (heal, coverage, edit, name, describe, signing, session, export), or map sites you haven't used: by name (explore) or from capture files (import). build makes one tested ability for a task (goal) by doing it once in a background tab; a write is learned in dry run. ability lists or runs one site ability (its API first, then replay steps, page code or node code); key makes a write apply once, limit/cursor page a list, test runs its stored cases. code reads routes, chunks, source maps, robots and sitemap before guessing URLs. Calls use the user's logins.

name.description: For action and channel: its name.

change.description: For edit: the change in plain English.

flow.description: For describe: the flow to perform.

url.description: For describe: the page to start at.

folder.description: For export: the folder to write into.

actions.description: For explore: also map actions in dry run.

sites.description: For explore: site names or URLs to map.

goal.description: For explore: extra things to do. For build: the task the ability does.

kind.description: For build: read (default) or write; a write is learned in dry run.

files.description: For learn/import: capture files in the workspace.

key.description: For watch: the item identifier. For a write ability: an idempotency key; the same key never applies twice within a day.

limit.description: For a list ability: rows per page; the answer is {items, next_cursor, has_more}.

cursor.description: For a list ability: next_cursor from the previous page, exactly as returned.

test.description: For ability: run its stored test cases instead.

grep.description: For code: a string or regex to match in chunks and manifests.
